title: Home nursing
requestHint: A quick visit is one task at a fixed price. Shift care stays with the patient for longer. Prices are a guide in EGP and include basic supplies.
emptyDescription: Home nursing requests will show up here.
shiftsHint: A nurse stays with the patient for the shift
notify: Save price and mark patient informed
pendingAccount: Your account is waiting for administration to verify your nursing proof. Requests arrive only after verification.
rejectedAccount: Administration rejected this account. Contact them and submit proof again.
registerSubtitle: After you register, administration reviews your proof before requests can reach you.
